outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed cell/status.json evaluations pass both modes at 40/40, so there is no discordant official outcome to explain. The process timeout occurred after artifact-producing work, so it affected closure state rather than the official test outcome.
serial_contributors: Direct single-agent implementation and fuzz-driven fixes produced a cleanly completed artifact accepted by the same official evaluator.
The serial run finished with explicit final response and remaining budget.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel pursued additional std::stof, NaN, infinity, and hex-float edge behavior before timeout; serial stopped after broad zero-mismatch fuzz and clean rebuild.
